column1: # The report Excel ("Справочник состояний") is the source of truth for condition -> group.
# A pathology title is a " + "-joined list of condition names; each part is looked up in
# the Excel by its English name. A few title parts are synonyms, typos, unresolved SNOMED
# codes or legacy wording that do NOT appear verbatim in the Excel. Map those parts here.
# The group key must be one of the keys in the bundled groups.txt
#  electrolyte, syndromes, pacemaker, special, pediatric, newborn, pregnant, clinical).
# Lines starting with '#' and blank lines are ignored. Matching is case-insensitive
# and whitespace-normalised. Edit freely: entries here override / extend the Excel map.
myocardial infraction in the side wall
sinus atrium to atrial wandering rhythm
# --- rhythms not spelled the same as the Excel ---
